Summary: Role of Nurse Practitioners
Nurse Practitioners need to be able to identify patients at risk for CHD using the 
NCEP and AHA guidelines and determine appropriate LDL-C goals. Recognition of 


Chapter 8  Cardiology Care   179
the important role that nutrition plays in patients with CHD, HTN, and HF will help 
Nurse Practitioners gain knowledge and skills in this area and be able to provide 
appropriate nutritional guidance and evidence-based practice to their patients. Given 
a patient’s medical, social, dietary history, and laboratory data Nurse Practitioners 
completing this chapter will be able to develop lifestyle goals with their patients to 
reduce risk for CHD and HTN.
